item.title: I noticed the 2 Hessian Refinement of MACaQ can be applied to any GGUF without any patches ... and tried it. 13% better quants
item.description: TLDR: Qwen3.8-27B UD_4_XL quant with 13.23% less KL divergence than unsloth (on my small testset, I just have a single 5090, feel free to test more). Technically it performs 4% better on my LiveCodeBench be | why kept: unsloth, qwen, qwen, free, quant
